asset.name: VirtualizationAdapter
asset.description: Connects lists, grids, calendars, logs, and option collections to a windowing engine through stable measurement, focus preservation, and scroll anchoring.

requires.reason: Boundary types come from the shared framework-light vocabulary rather than being redeclared per adapter.

rationale: Focus preservation is part of the contract rather than the engine's concern: a window change that drops keyboard focus is observable as the interface losing the user's place.
